page.overview:
What is Thalarion?

Thalarion is a fictional extra-dimensional location created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "The White Ship".

Thalarion is a coastal city in the Dreamlands of Earth, also known as the City of a Thousand Wonders, a mighty city surrounded by grey stone walls that hide most of the frieze covered buildings and alluring sculptures. Its temple spires however reach into the sky, far enough for their peaks to be invisible to the naked eye. Within the walls its streets are littered with unburied bones.

A stone pier leads to the huge carven gate of Akariel.

Though many men enter none leave and the streets are home to daemons and mad things that are no longer men.
